title: A run's brief needs a person
tagline: Edits to the file an unattended run obeys never merge on their own
intro: Low-risk changes can merge on their own once the checks are green.

steps.say: An edit to a run's brief now always goes to a person for review, wherever the file lives.
Edits to the other files in a run still take the quick route.

outro: The cost is that a change touching only a brief now waits for a human.
